overview_description.description: At BankDhofar we strive to be ‘the best bank for you’ by making banking easy. BankDhofar currently has a nationwide network of 68 branches and 145 ATMs and 52 CDMs across the length and breadth of the Sultanate. As one of the fastest growing financial services institution in the Sultanate, we offer Corporate banking, Consumer banking, Treasury and Project Finance services - designed to meet the diverse needs of consumers, small and medium size businesses and mid-market companies in the region.

product.name: Personal Banking
product.description: Personal banking services for individuals, including current accounts, savings accounts, expatriate, youth, children’s and ladies’ accounts, supported by branch and digital access.

product.name: Loans and Credit Solutions
product.description: Consumer and business lending for housing, personal expenses, vehicles and other approved purposes, with repayment terms based on borrower eligibility and product conditions.

product.name: Corporate Banking
product.description: Banking services for companies and institutions, including financing, accounts, payments, cash management and other solutions for corporate financial operations.

product.name: SME Banking (Numo)
product.description: Specialized banking services for small and medium-sized enterprises, covering business accounts, financing, payments and financial management needs.

product.name: Credit Cards
product.description: Credit cards for purchases, online payments and cash advances, with options differing by eligibility, limits, fees, rewards and premium features.

product.name: Deposits and Savings Plans
product.description: Savings and deposit products for holding funds, earning returns and planning for short- or long-term goals in Omani rials and selected foreign currencies.
